Ultralytics YOLO unified inference

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform, --target {auto,x5,s100,s100p,s600}
                        Target platform. When omitted, the board is detected
                        from /sys/class/boardinfo. Preparation may select any
                        target; inference requires matching local board
                        identity. (default: None)
  --task {detect,seg,pose,cls,obb}
                        Task type. (default: detect)
  --family FAMILY       Model family, for example yolo11, yolov8, yolov10 or
                        yolov5u. (default: None)
  --model-size MODEL_SIZE
                        Model scale, for example n, s, m, l, x. Defaults to
                        the family default of the platform. (default: None)
  --model-path MODEL_PATH
                        Path to a compiled model. Overrides the resolved
                        default path and is never downloaded. (default: None)
  --asset-id ASSET_ID   Exact existing manifest reference
                        group:sample:filename; use --list-models to inspect
                        references. (default: None)
  --input-shape INPUT_SHAPE
                        Explicit model input geometry as HxW, used only when
                        the runtime does not report it. (default: None)
  --test-img TEST_IMG   Path to the test image. (default: /Users/Max/Workspace
                        /company/development/RDK_MODEL_ZOO/rdk-b7-board-integr
                        ation/samples/vision/ultralytics_yolo/test_data/bus.jp
                        g)
  --label-file LABEL_FILE
                        Path to a label file. Defaults to the sample COCO
                        labels for detect/seg/pose and the sample ImageNet
                        labels for cls. (default: None)
  --img-save-path IMG_SAVE_PATH
                        Path to save the rendered result image. (default:
                        result.jpg)
  --score-thres SCORE_THRES
                        Confidence score threshold. (default: 0.25)
  --nms-thres NMS_THRES
                        IoU threshold for NMS. Defaults to the value the
                        selected platform documents. (default: None)
  --resize-type {0,1}   Resize policy: 0 stretch, 1 letterbox. Defaults to the
                        value the selected platform documents. (default: None)
  --classes-num CLASSES_NUM
  --strides STRIDES
  --mc MC
  --angle-sign ANGLE_SIGN
  --angle-offset ANGLE_OFFSET
                        OBB offset in degrees (default: 0.0)
  --regularize {0,1}
  --reg REG             Number of DFL regression bins. (default: 16)
  --nkpt NKPT           [Pose] Number of keypoints. (default: 17)
  --topk TOPK           [Cls] Top-K classification results. (default: 5)
  --kpt-conf-thres KPT_CONF_THRES
                        [Pose] Keypoint visibility threshold. (default: 0.5)
  --priority PRIORITY   Model priority (0~255). 0 is lowest, 255 highest.
                        (default: 0)
  --bpu-cores BPU_CORES [BPU_CORES ...]
                        BPU core indexes to run inference on. (default: [0])
  --list-models         List the model assets the selected platform publishes,
                        then exit. Needs no board runtime. (default: False)
  --dry-run             Print the resolved model path and download URL, then
                        exit without downloading or running. Needs no board
                        runtime. (default: False)
  --download            Download the resolved model if it is missing, then
                        exit without running inference. (default: False)
